what_happened: render_next()'s existing terminal-member-omission convention and build_ready_pool()'s readiness predicate together gave an exact, reusable precedent for the roadmap-aware candidate filter -- no new readiness logic had to be designed, and a live jq simulation against the current state.json confirmed the proposed walk-and-filter rule behaves sensibly (4 leading batches skip at zero probe cost, 5th batch's singleton [577] is the first live candidate).

Research report 01 pre-settled the design decision (Direction (a)) with live-corpus validation and an enumerated test list, so plan authoring needed only sizing/sequencing plus two new mechanical findings (usage() sed-range coupling at orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh:99 and the index-entries.json line_count coupling for the template edit); no re-derivation of the diagnosis was needed.
